policy.legacy_behavior: Preserve all existing validators and non-Product-Alpha triggers.
policy.mixed_change_behavior: Any non-Product-Alpha file in a change set keeps legacy workflows eligible.
policy.product_alpha_behavior: Ignore Product Alpha-only runtime, Python-test, Node-test, and Product-Alpha-CI file sets in legacy pull_request and push events.
policy.product_ci_behavior: A validate-product-alpha.yml change runs Product Alpha and Workflow Scope, while unrelated historical workflows remain ineligible unless the change set is mixed.
